environment.description: ECS Fargate service running behind an Application Load Balancer with a CloudFront distribution in front. The CloudFront distribution has a Response Headers Policy (ID: managed-policy-67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) attached which injects Content-Security-Policy headers. The policy specifies: script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' wss://*.internal.corp.net; frame-ancestors 'none'. The CloudFront distribution is the ONLY ingress path (ALB security group restricts inbound to CloudFront managed prefix list com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing). Additionally, the ECS task IAM role has a permissions boundary that prevents ssm:SendCommand and the task uses a read-only root filesystem. The Fargate platform version is 1.4.0 with runtime platform Linux/ARM64.
